dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Hearing you say this, I feel a bit more relieved.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Anyway, I've done the best I could, now it's all up to destiny.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: By the way, these are the Padisarah I cultivated during my research.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: Smells amazing, right? Please take them as a gift. I just hope all our wishes will come true.
